_about: How a player answers a monster's skill (src/playbook.ts). What CAN dodge a skill is a fact about it (mob-skills.json 'avoid'); this file is the player's preference among those.
Layers, most specific wins field by field: skills.<AEGIS> (every class, every monster) < classes.<Class>.skills.<AEGIS> < mobs.<Monster>.<AEGIS> < classes.<Class>.mobs.<Monster>.<AEGIS>.

prefer: the ways to try, best first -- only these are tried; if none works in time it is tanked. Ways: gambit (King's Gambit), walk (walk out), hide (Hiding), decoy, rod (Pawn's Rod), los (behind cover), manhole (step into one), kawarimi, barrier (Queen's Barrier), backslide, slashout (Shadow Slash out). A class that lacks a way skips it.
always: dodge it whatever it would do; otherwise only a heavy hit is (tankShare / a quarter of HP, or a bad status).
A skill with no entry here is left to the class kit's own reactions.

archetypes: with profile option defense 'auto' (src/kits/defense.ts), a skill with no 'prefer' entry is answered by the shape of its cast instead: area-slow (an area with time to walk out), area-fast (an area without), single-slow (a cast at you with time to get behind cover), single-fast (a cast at you without, or no cast bar). Each list is tried in order; 'a|b' tries both and takes the cheaper (SP, time off the target, cooldown). classes.<Class>.archetypes overrides one for a class.

Threat decides how far down the list it goes: a light hit (expected damage after flee and Auto Guard, under tankShare) is tanked; a heavy one uses any way but the reserved ones (Queen's Barrier, and a tool kept for a monster's instant killer); a lethal one (would kill, or a disabling status) may use those too.

WL_EARTHSTRAIN.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: walk behind the caster or Hide. The line runs away from the caster, so behind it is a short step (mob-skills.json escapeCells).

SP_SWHOO.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Umbral Knight): Hiding or line of sight. Pawn's Rod: 'fairly sure' it stops it (magic, and Hiding does) -- not yet tested in game.

SO_DIAMONDDUST.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Tidal Knight): Hiding dodges it. One hit (skill_db Duration1 100 ms), so Hiding's 2 s covers it; 9x9 is too wide to walk out of at the wall's pace.

WZ_VERMILION.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Tornado Knight): Hiding dodges it. One wave here (skill_db Duration1 1000 ms against a 1250 ms tick), so Hiding's 2 s covers it; radius 7 is a long walk.

WZ_HEAVENDRIVE.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Quake Knight): walk out of the smaller areas when there is time (5x5), saving King's Gambit; Hiding dodges it live (the 2023 flag TargetHidden is not live).

NPC_VAMPIRE_GIFT.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (the Tomb knights): walk out of the smaller areas when there is time, saving King's Gambit for the big ones.

Rogue.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: any rogue-based job (Kingslayer, Sinner, Arcane Master, Blast Juggler -- the lineage in crawler/class-rules.json) answers a non-boss single-target skill with Decoy first; Pawn's Rod if it is magic; Hiding or walking out of line of sight last. Against a boss (formulas countsAsBoss: MVP, server Boss class, Rachel SS / Jorm lair boss protocol) the default order, and Decoy is never an answer there: it is its own state, not Hiding, and the owner assumes it only fools non-boss monsters (2026-09-29, untested). Hiding stops single-target casts from anything, boss protocol and detectors included (owner).

NJ_HUUJIN.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Tornado Knight's Wind Blade, ~11-15k): always answered; the order is classes.Rogue's (Decoy, Pawn's Rod, Hiding / line of sight).

NJ_HYOUSENSOU.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Tidal Knight's Freezing Spear, ~12-15k): always answered; the order is classes.Rogue's (Decoy, Pawn's Rod, Hiding / line of sight).

KO_KAIHOU.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29 (Quake Knight's Eruption, ~11-15k): always answered; the order is classes.Rogue's (Decoy, Pawn's Rod, Hiding / line of sight).

WL_EARTHSTRAIN.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: King's Gambit also cancels it, but it is an easy walk.

AB_ADORAMUS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: not a fast cast (2.5 s), easy to answer. Pawn's Rod eats it (RTM skill_attack: Magic Rod takes any magic the caster lands itself, a splash too); Hiding next (a boss-protocol swing can break it); line of sight last. ~19k a hit on the owner, two thirds of his HP.

WL_COMET.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: always Hiding or King's Gambit; too wide to walk out of.

WZ_METEOR.note: Project owner, 2026-09-29: King's Gambit works, but it is easier to walk away when there is time.
